agent.problem: Stop 1, card 7 quotes "O unbelieving generation! How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you?", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards gives the baker a basis for choosing “mute” over “blind” or “lame.” The blank asks for an unseen detail that can only be guessed.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
